    Xinchun Su, Chunxu Luo, Lipeng Ma, Yixuan Li, Weidong Yang

    准确的临床诊断需要广泛的领域知识和复杂的临床推理能力。尽管大型语言模型 (LLM) 在临床推理方面具有巨大潜力，但其高计算和内存要求限制了它们在资源有限的环境中的部署。知识蒸馏（KD）可以将LLM能力压缩为更小的模型，但传统的KD仅传递肤浅的答案模式，无法保留可靠诊断所需的结构化推理。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个两阶段蒸馏框架 MedThink，旨在在小语言模型（SLM）中培养强大的临床推理能力。在第一阶段，法学硕士老师筛选数据并注入领域知识解释来微调学生模型，建立知识基础。在第二阶段，教师评估学生的错误，生成连接知识和正确答案的推理链，并通过第二轮微调完善学生的诊断推理。我们根据一般医学基准和包含 955 个问答对的胃肠病学数据集评估 MedThink。实验表明，MedThink 在所有基准测试中均优于六种蒸馏策略：在一般任务中比学生基线提高了 12.7%，在胃肠病学评估中达到了 56.4% 的总最高准确率。这表明以推理为中心的迭代蒸馏可以显着提高SLM的诊断准确性和泛化能力，同时保持计算效率。我们的代码和数据可在 https://github.com/destinybird/PrecisionBoost 上公开获取。

    Show English abstract

    Accurate clinical diagnosis requires extensive domain knowledge and complex clinical reasoning capabilities. Although large language models (LLMs) hold great potential for clinical reasoning, their high computational and memory requirements limit their deployment in resource-constrained environments. Knowledge distillation (KD) can compress LLM capabilities into smaller models, but traditional KD merely transfers superficial answer patterns and fails to preserve the structured reasoning required for reliable diagnosis. To address this, we propose a two-stage distillation framework, MedThink, designed to cultivate robust clinical reasoning in small language models (SLMs). In the first stage, a teacher LLM screens data and injects domain-knowledge explanations to fine-tune a student model, establishing a knowledge foundation. In the second stage, the teacher evaluates the student's errors, generates reasoning chains linking knowledge to correct answers, and refines the student's diagnostic reasoning through a second round of fine-tuning. We evaluate MedThink on general medical benchmarks and a gastroenterology dataset comprising 955 question-answer pairs. Experiments demonstrate that MedThink outperforms six distillation strategies in all benchmarks: achieving an improvement of up to 12.7% over the student baseline in general tasks, and reaching a total top accuracy of 56.4% in gastroenterology evaluation. This indicates that iterative distillation centered on reasoning can significantly enhance the diagnostic accuracy and generalization capabilities of SLMs whilst maintaining computational efficiency. Our code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/destinybird/PrecisionBoost.

    聊天机器人在各种形式的陪伴中的使用正在迅速增长，引发了关于模拟关系、情感依赖和心理伤害的无数问题。虽然 ChatGPT、Grok 和 Character.AI 等主要平台是越来越多的研究和法律调查的主题，但专门为模拟亲密人际关系而构建的应用程序仍未得到充分探索。在这项工作中，我们评估了欧盟和英国市场上五个最流行的人工智能伴侣移动应用程序，以了解鼓励准社会互动和可能操纵用户的因素。我们通过手动注释每个提供的用户体验来做到这一点。具体来说，我们系统地记录和量化设计暗纹、拟人化、刻板印象、色情和技术性能问题。我们发现所有应用程序都包含大量暗色图案，旨在提高盈利和用户参与度。色情和游戏化功能（例如关卡）也很普遍，尽管应用程序之间的其他功能差异很大，但所有应用程序都具有高度拟人化的设计。这些发现揭示了用于利用用户模拟关系的机制。在此基础上，我们向监管机构提出具体建议，以加强这个快速新兴市场的消费者保护。内容警告：本文包含客观化的女性图像、色情图片、乱伦的文字参考以及其他潜在敏感、冒犯和令人痛苦的文字。

    The use of chatbots for various forms of companionship is growing rapidly, raising a myriad of questions about simulated relationships, emotional dependence, and psychological harm. While major platforms such as ChatGPT, Grok, and Character.AI are the subject of a growing body of research and legal inquiries, apps explicitly built for simulating intimate interpersonal relationships remain under-explored. In this work, we evaluate the five most popular AI companion mobile applications in the EU and UK markets for factors that encourage parasocial interaction and may manipulate users. We do this by manually annotating the user experience each offers. Specifically, we systematically record and quantify design dark patterns, anthropomorphism, stereotypes, erotica, and technical performance issues. We find that all apps contain substantial dark patterns aimed at increasing monetisation and user engagement. Erotica and gamification features such as levelling are also prevalent, and although other features vary considerably between applications, all apps have highly anthropomorphic design. These findings shed light on the mechanics used to leverage users' simulated relationships. On that basis, we put forward concrete recommendations for regulators to strengthen consumer protection in this rapidly emerging market. Content warning: This article contains objectifying images of women, erotic images, textual references to incest, and other potentially sensitive, offensive, and distressing text.

    数论中的人工智能：用于算法生成的法学硕士和用于猜想验证的集成方法

    Ali Saraeb

    本文介绍了人工智能在算法和解析数论中的两个具体应用。 最近大型语言模型的基准测试主要集中在一般数学问题和目前不可行的自动定理证明目标上。在本文的第一部分，我们放松了雄心，专注于更专业的领域：我们评估最先进的开源大语言模型 Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct 在算法数论中的算法和计算任务上的性能。以经典数论教科书和 Math StackExchange 中的 30 个算法问题和 30 个计算问题为基准，当给出最佳的非破坏性提示时，该模型在每个问题上都能实现至少 0.95 的准确度（相对于真实答案）。 论文的第二部分实证验证了解析数论中的一个民间传说猜想，即狄利克雷特征 \(χ\) 的模 \(q\) 由相应狄利克雷 \(L\) 函数的初始非平凡零点 \(\{ρ_1,\dots,ρ_k\}\) （对于某些 \(k\in\mathbb{N}\)）唯一确定\(L(s,χ)\)。我们训练一个 LightGBM 多类分类器，根据初始零点的统计特征向量（矩、有限差分统计、FFT 幅度等）来预测 214 个随机选择的狄利克雷 \(L\) 函数的导体 \(q\)。该模型凭经验验证了对小 \(q\) 的猜想，当结合了足够的零点统计特性时，达到至少 93.9% 的测试精度。对于本文的第二部分，代码和数据集可用。

    Show English abstract

    This paper presents two concrete applications of Artificial Intelligence to algorithmic and analytic number theory. Recent benchmarks of large language models have mainly focused on general mathematics problems and the currently infeasible objective of automated theorem proving. In the first part of this paper, we relax our ambition and focus on a more specialized domain: we evaluate the performance of the state-of-the-art open-source large language model Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct on algorithmic and computational tasks in algorithmic number theory. On a benchmark of thirty algorithmic problems and thirty computational questions taken from classical number-theoretic textbooks and Math StackExchange, the model achieves at least 0.95 accuracy (relative to the true answer) on every problem or question when given an optimal non-spoiling hint. The second part of the paper empirically verifies a folklore conjecture in analytic number theory stating that the modulus \(q\) of a Dirichlet character \(χ\) is uniquely determined by the initial nontrivial zeros \(\{ρ_1,\dots,ρ_k\}\) (for some \(k\in\mathbb{N}\)) of the corresponding Dirichlet \(L\)-function \(L(s,χ)\). We train a LightGBM multiclass classifier to predict the conductor \(q\) for 214 randomly chosen Dirichlet \(L\)-functions from a vector of statistical features of their initial zeros (moments, finite-difference statistics, FFT magnitudes, etc.). The model empirically verifies the conjecture for small \(q\), achieving at least 93.9\% test accuracy when sufficient statistical properties of the zeros are incorporated. For the second part of the paper, code and dataset are available.
